newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 25 killed in tribal clash in India.
newsitem.headline: At least 25 killed in tribal clash in India.

text.p: At least 25 people were killed and five seriously injured when armed tribesmen attacked a rival group in India's remote northeastern state of Manipur on Monday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
The armed Kuki militants opened fire on rival Naga tribals at a village in Churachandpur district of Manipur about noon (0630 GMT), the news agency said.
The militants also set ablaze and destroyed over 18 houses in the village before fleeing to a nearby jungle, it added.
The police have begun a search for the Kukis. No arrests have been made, PTI said.
